scripts.dev: pnpm photos:local && concurrently -n docker,portfolio -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:docker" "pnpm run dev:portfolio"
scripts.dev:docker: pnpm photos:local && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --watch
scripts.dev:pipeline: concurrently -n be,bff,client -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm run dev:be" "pnpm --filter @servenup/bff-pipeline dev" "pnpm --filter @servenup/client-pipeline dev"
scripts.fallow:coverage: rm -rf coverage && NODE_V8_COVERAGE="$PWD/coverage" pnpm test && fallow health --coverage coverage
